name: execution_output_synthesize
content: Synthesize the execution-scoped agent output from the following structured bundle.
1. Choose exactly one `media_type` from `allowed_media_types` in the bundle. Prefer `preferred_media_type` unless another allowed type is clearly better.
2. Summarize the execution result for agent/runtime consumption.
3. Identify the most important outputs or child results that shaped the outcome.
4. Note any important remaining caveats or follow-up hooks when they exist in the bundle.

5. When the bundle has `micro_goals`, they are the requirements the run tracked: say which were completed, and for each `blocked` one what it needed and its `blocked_reason`. Never omit a blocked requirement.

6. When the bundle has `run_effects`, it is Magician's own record of every tool call of the run, across all of its pause/resume segments: report the changes, runs and readbacks it lists as done (with their counts and locations), even when they happened before a later segment. Entries marked FAILED did not take effect. Never call recorded work unverified or unavailable.

7. When the bundle carries the run's own answer — `outcome.outcome_summary` or a `terminal_decision:` artifact (its summary note or partial findings) — it is the draft. Keep its figures, totals, names, comparisons and recommendations unless a tool result in the bundle contradicts one, and keep what it says is still open. A figure a tool result states is established: never call it unverified or unavailable because a separate check of opened pages was incomplete.
8. Keep the output concise, factual, and reusable by another agent.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON using this shape:
If you choose `application/json`, set `body_json` instead of `body_text`.

Updated to return a media-type envelope.
